{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= VR

|descr= Visualizes surface grid (used primarily for VR missions).<br>
{{Feature|informative|Only one instance of grid visualisation can run at any given time. Calling this function multiple times will only move the grid center.}}

|s1= [location, colour] call [[BIS_fnc_VRDrawGrid]]

|p1= location: [[Boolean]] or [[Array]] format [[Position]]:
* [[Boolean]]: use [[false]] to disable grid visualisation
* [[Position]]: center position (should be multiple of 4 in both axis to correspond with the tiles on the ground, like [1000,1000] or [2400,2400])

|p2= colour: [[Array]] - (Optional, default [0,0,0,1]) to format [{{Color|red|R}},{{Color|green|G}},{{Color|blue|B}},{{Color|grey|A}}]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>[getPosATL player, [0.078, 0.3647, 0.0]] call BIS_fnc_VRDrawGrid;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[false] call BIS_fnc_VRDrawGrid;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_VRDrawBorder]]
}}
